chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 135: Li Huowang's Mother, Rock-Eating Madness, and a New Resolve
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang is found eating rocks and hallucinating his mother. After a tense reunion, he decides to map the factions of the Dao-Twisted world, starting with a trip back to Anci Nunnery.
og_title: Found: A Mother's Voice in the Madness
og_description: A quiet, painful chapter of recovery and planning. Li Huowang is found in a dissociative state, and his journey from victim to strategist begins.
twitter_title: The Rock Eater's Map: Li Huowang starts his survey of hell.
twitter_description: Found in the mud, talking to his mom, Li Huowang emerges from a fugue state ready to become the cartographer of a nightmare.
